required_source_behavior.input_discovery: forbidden; every root, metadata table, official split source, devkit identity, map source, CAN source and expected content address must be explicit
required_source_behavior.release_identity: bind v1.0-trainval release, devkit version/package/source commit, metadata archive or directory identity, every required table byte SHA256 and row count, and one canonical metadata digest
required_source_behavior.foreign_key_and_chain_closure: recompute every required token reference and reciprocal prev/next chain from log through scene, sample, sample_data, calibrated_sensor, ego_pose, sensor, annotation, instance, category, attribute, visibility, map and CAN linkage
required_source_behavior.official_split: derive only from an explicitly addressed official devkit split source; forbid missing-source fallback and prove every complete log is wholly contained in one official partition
required_source_behavior.population_ledger: emit one canonical row per complete log_token binding ordered scene, sample and all sample_data tokens, first/last UTC timestamps, location, official partition, descendant counts and source-row hashes
required_source_behavior.registered_files: stream-hash every registered sample_data file for the six cameras and LIDAR_TOP, including all selected-channel sweep/frame records; reject missing, duplicate, symlinked, escaping, non-regular or changed-during-read paths
required_source_behavior.map_and_can: content-address map and CAN source identities and files, prove explicit complete-log linkage, and reject missing, duplicate, unknown or cross-log associations
required_source_behavior.validation: provide a deterministic pure semantic validator that reopens the staged bundle, recomputes canonical hashes/counts/coverage/closure and rejects unknown fields, duplicate JSON keys, Booleans as integers, non-finite values and noncanonical JSON/JSONL
required_source_behavior.publication: write only to a private staging directory, validate before publication, recheck staged bytes after validation, and use atomic no-replace publication; failure leaves no accepted output
required_source_behavior.resource_boundary: stream file hashing and bounded per-table/per-log state only; no persistent cache, derived model artifact, checkpoint or accelerator dependency

required_synthetic_attacks: foreign-key escape or incomplete all-table closure
one log_token crossing official train and validation partitions
missing official split source or fallback_sorted_scene_80_20 substitution
asserted counts substituted for observed counts
metadata table byte or canonical digest substitution
missing, duplicate, symlinked, path-escaping or changed-during-read sensor file
omitted camera, LIDAR_TOP or required sweep/frame record
missing or incorrect map-to-log or CAN-to-log linkage
partial log, scene, sample or all-sample_data population ledger
unknown output field, duplicate JSON key, Boolean integer or non-finite value
pre-existing output directory, post-validation byte change and partial publication
explicitly_not_authorized: real nuScenes or NAVSIM metadata, sensor, map, CAN, info-PKL or raw-data access
real N0 provenance receipt or population ledger generation
real session-atomic manifest or membership generation
dataset materialization, info-PKL generation, anchor fitting or cache creation
model import, checkpoint access, T0, CUDA, GPU, training, evaluation or final-test access
performance claim, controller promotion, publication, push or 06G dispatch
movement, rewrite, amendment, reset or rebase of RC4, RC3, RC2, RC1, research, recovery, controller or public refs
next_gate: controller audit of the exact one-commit provenance-source candidate; only a later separate controller authorization may permit a real N0 scan
